verdict.rationale: Marqeta supports automatic rule-based actions in specific domains: velocity/authorization controls automatically enforce spend limits per user-defined thresholds, JIT funding lets a customer's system apply custom approve/deny business logic on funding-request events, and webhooks notify external systems as events occur. However there is no evidence of a general-purpose, user-configurable event→condition→action automation/rules engine beyond these built-in control types — missing for 10: a generic rule builder for arbitrary triggers/actions, evidence of chaining multiple actions per event, and any UI/no-code rule configuration beyond API-defined controls.
